title: ATAP DB release unit manifest v2
description: Schema for db/releases/<x.y.z>.yml files that declare a database change unit. Supports schema-only, data-only, and schema+data packages.

schemaVersion.description: Format version of this release-unit manifest schema.

appVersion.description: Application version associated with this DB change unit.

dbChangeUnit.description: Stable identity for the DB change unit (e.g. 'ATAPUtilities-db').

changeKind.description: Declares whether this package contains schema migrations, seed/reference data, or both. Controls which validation gates apply.

dataKind.description: Sub-classification of data content. Required when changeKind is 'data' or 'schemaAndData'. Absent when changeKind is 'schema'.

flywayTargetVersion.description: Flyway schema version reached after applying this change unit.

migrations.description: Ordered versioned Flyway migration SQL files included in the change unit.

repeatables.description: Repeatable Flyway SQL files included in the change unit.

seedFiles.description: CSV seed files included in the change unit.

seedLoaders.description: SQL or PowerShell scripts that load seed files. Must each declare idempotency.

expectedRowCounts.description: Expected table row counts after loading seed data. Keys are table names.

compatibleAppPackageRanges.description: SemVer ranges of application package versions that this DB change unit is compatible with. Empty array means 'no constraint'.

requiresPreviousProductionSnapshot.description: When true, the rehearsal gate must restore a production snapshot before running Flyway. Indicates irreversible or data-sensitive migration.

rollbackSupported.description: Whether downgrade from this DB change unit is supported. If false, promotion past Integration requires explicit override.

rollbackNotes.description: Operational rollback guidance. Required even when rollbackSupported is true.

evidenceRequirements.description: Per-tier evidence gates that must be satisfied before promotion.

notes.description: Human-readable operational notes for this change unit.

semVerRange.description: SemVer range expression (npm/NuGet style). E.g. '>=1.0.0 <2.0.0' or '[1.0,2.0)'.

destructiveChangeKind.description: Classification of the most destructive operation in a migration script.

checksumSha256.description: SHA-256 of the migration SQL file.

destructiveChangeKind.description: Most destructive operation in this script. 'none' means additive-only.

notes.description: Optional human note about this migration.

checksumSha256.description: SHA-256 of the repeatable SQL file.
SHA-256 of the CSV seed file.

expectedRowCount.description: Expected row count after loading. Optional; overrides expectedRowCounts table-level value.

fileName.description: SQL or PowerShell seed loader filename.

isIdempotent.description: True when the loader is safe to run multiple times without changing the result. Required for rehearsal gate re-runs.

evidenceRequirements.description: Evidence gates per promotion tier. Each key is a tier name.

flywayRehearsalRequired.description: Flyway rehearsal must pass before promotion to this tier.

rowCountValidationRequired.description: Expected row counts must be verified after apply.

snapshotBackupRequired.description: A pre-apply snapshot backup is required before Flyway runs at this tier.

approvalRequired.description: Human approval gate in BuildMaster before promotion to this tier.
